name: Asarfi Hospital Ltd
title: Asarfi Hospital Ltd - 543943 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asarfi FY26 consolidated revenue up 42% to INR173.5 cr with 20% EBITDA margin, but no supply discipline signal: bed expansion to 500+ and FY27 INR260 cr target rest on an unannounced acquisition and cancer bed adds, with receivables aged 6-7 months.

utilisation.quote: It is only, we are at 42% of capacity utilization of 65 beds

capex.quote: the current year capex would be between the tune of INR10 crores to INR12 crores, is that right?

triggers.label: Receivables aging 6-7 months
triggers.quote: with regard to aging, it is around six to seven months.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue target INR260 cr
triggers.quote: Yes, sir, we are working very hard and we should be able to achieve it.

triggers.label: Cancer bed count 65 to 150
triggers.quote: expansion of cancer hospital capacity from 65 beds to 150 beds

triggers.label: Organ transplant approval repeatedly delayed
triggers.quote: we are trying to obtain approval for the organ transplant facility

guidance.quote: what could be a top-line target for FY27 as you have mentioned it will be INR260 crores
We definitely would like to push it to at least 22% next year.
achieving revenue of around INR400 crores, and improving EBITDA margin to 23% to 25%
scaling overall bed capacity to 500 plus beds
you targeted for 13% to 15% of PAT for the FY27

prior_guidance_check.quote: we had communicated that it will be started in around the last quarter of 2026 financial year
hopefully it should be done this financial year

red_flags.label: Receivables aged 6-7 months, government scheme delays
red_flags.quote: with regard to aging, it is around six to seven months.

red_flags.label: Cancer hospital ARPOB sharp decline and patient drop
red_flags.quote: there is a sharp decline in ARPOB during the quarter

red_flags.label: Prior timelines missed (bone marrow, acquisition)
red_flags.quote: we had communicated that it will be started in around the last quarter of 2026 financial year

red_flags.label: Promoter-linked merger stalled by unresolved share inheritance
red_flags.quote: two or three shareholders had died and the heirs have not inherited the shares

evasions.topic: Cancer hospital EBITDA margin and utilisation outlook
evasions.quote: we require some number crunching, and if you could write a mail to us

evasions.topic: Other income INR3.66 cr in March 2025
evasions.quote: Details of other income will be mailed to you.
what exact model we will be moving ahead, that is why we have not added hospitals
